name: Google Gemini API (AI Studio)
free_tier: Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Flash-Lite, 2.5 Pro (limited), embeddings, TTS models
rate_limits: Sampled Gemini 2.5 model limits are shown only in AI Studio; quotas vary by model and project. Public docs separately publish selected model quotas, including Gemini Decision 1
notes: Free-tier prompts/outputs may be used by Google to improve its products outside the UK/CH/EEA/EU. Since the 2026-03-23 terms, only Paid Services may serve API clients to end users in the EEA/CH/UK. Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash are deprecated; the pricing page announces automatic routing to Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite respectively, billed at their rates, from 2026-12-01
best_for: The only frontier-class model with a genuine free tier

name: Groq
free_tier: Open-weight models (GPT-OSS, Qwen) plus Whisper, no credit card required
rate_limits: Free plan examples: openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b and qwen/qwen3.8-27b: 30 RPM/1K RPD/8K TPM/200K TPD; Whisper models: 20 RPM/2K RPD/7.2K audio seconds/hour and 28.8K/day; limits vary by model
notes: Limits apply at the organization level, not per API key. Phone verification required at signup
best_for: Lowest-latency inference for open-weight models

name: OpenRouter
free_tier: A rotating set of models with a :free suffix, single API across many providers; availability fluctuates
rate_limits: 20 requests/min; published table: 50 requests/day below 10 credits purchased lifetime, 1,000/day at 10+; docs say the higher daily ceiling starts one credit below the threshold to absorb fees and rounding
notes: Terms prohibit reselling API access or developing a competing service; per-model terms still apply. Upstream providers may train on inputs/outputs. Separate settings for free and paid models can exclude providers that train; router-level opt-in logging and safety/legal retention exceptions still apply (official terms, privacy and provider-logging docs read 2026-11-14).
best_for: Widest model selection behind one no-card key

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
free_tier: 10,000 Neurons/day, all account plans
rate_limits: 10,000 Neurons/day (free allocation). Default text generation: 300 requests/min; models requiring paid billing: 20/min with standard billing or 50/min with prepaid AI Gateway credits. Text embeddings: 3,000/min (bge-large-en-v1.5: 1,500/min); speech recognition, text-to-image, translation and image-to-text: 720/min, with model exceptions
notes: Resets daily at 00:00 UTC; overage on a Workers Paid plan bills at $0.011/1,000 Neurons. Some models require a paid billing method: Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits; these are outside no-card free access
best_for: Highest free daily volume for a real side project

name: Cohere
free_tier: Trial (evaluation) API keys covering chat, embed and rerank
rate_limits: 1,000 API calls/month total; 20 req/min chat; 2,000 inputs/min embed; 10 req/min rerank
notes: Free evaluation key; production use requires upgrading to a production key. Cohere privacy policy says trial inputs and outputs may be used for research and product improvement; no trial-specific retention duration is confirmed
best_for: Free embeddings and rerank for RAG prototypes

name: Cerebras
free_tier: $5 in free credits for new accounts, usable across all public models
rate_limits: Free Trial, gpt-oss-120b: 5 RPM / 30,000 uncached TPM / 90,000 total TPM / 1,000,000 TPH / 1,000,000 TPD. Qwen 3.8 27B: 300 RPM / 150,000 uncached TPM, no hourly or daily token caps; the temporary total-TPM increase is excluded
notes: A verified payment method is required to activate Playground/API access; no charge until you separately purchase credits. The one-time $5 trial credit expires 30 days after grant. API and Playground access stop when it expires or is exhausted; there is no permanently free tier
best_for: Fastest tokens/sec on wafer-scale hardware

name: HuggingFace
free_tier: Free CPU Basic + ZeroGPU for Spaces; Inference Providers has no included credit on the Free plan (credits must be purchased) — $2.00/mo is included only on PRO/Team/Enterprise
rate_limits: No RPM/TPM published, only credit amounts
notes: Credits only apply with "Routed by Hugging Face" billing, not with a Custom Provider Key
best_for: Router access to many open-weight providers under one key

name: SiliconFlow
free_tier: China platform (siliconflow.cn): several models permanently free at ¥0 (e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, tencent/Hunyuan-MT-7B, BAAI embeddings and rerankers). The international platform (siliconflow.com) lists no $0 LLMs and gives $1 in free credits instead
rate_limits: Fixed per-model limits for free models; generic docs cite ranges of 1,000-10,000 RPM and 50,000-5,000,000 TPM depending on model tier — exact limits shown in-account
notes: Free models live on the China platform and need real-name authentication to use all of them; accepted documents are a mainland ID card, HK/Macao or Taiwan travel permits, HK/Macao/Taiwan residence permits or a Chinese permanent-residence card for foreigners. Signup is by phone number; some virtual-carrier number ranges are blocked.
best_for: Permanently-free open models, no trial clock

name: Z.ai (Zhipu AI / GLM)
free_tier: GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash (text), and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) are officially listed as $0 cost (input, cached input, and output) on a permanent basis
rate_limits: Not specified with concrete RPM/TPM figures in public docs
notes: Terms of Use prohibit using Z.ai to "develop, train, or enhance any algorithms, models, or technologies that directly or indirectly compete with us" — otherwise general use, including commercial, isn't restricted
best_for: A permanently-free model with no trial clock

name: IBM watsonx.ai (Lite plan)
free_tier: Lite plan: 300,000 tokens/month for foundation model inference, 20 CUH/month for ML tooling, 100 pages/month of document text extraction
rate_limits: 2 inference requests per second (explicitly documented for the Lite plan)
notes: Lite plan doesn't support fine-tuning of foundation or custom models; 1-day idle deployment timeout. Never expires or bills while inside quota, but a payment method (with a nominal ~$1 authorization hold) is required at signup
best_for: Governed enterprise inference with a monthly free quota

name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
free_tier: Seven models are currently listed as Free: two Qwen3Guard moderation models, Stable Diffusion XL and four NVIDIA Riva TTS voices; access is available anonymously or with an API key tied to a Public Cloud project
rate_limits: Anonymous access: 2 requests/min per IP per model. Authenticated (API key): 400 requests/min per project per model. Exceeding either returns HTTP 429
notes: European provider (France), relevant for EU data-sovereignty/GDPR-conscious use. The authenticated tier needs a valid payment method on the project (though "Free" models themselves don't charge); anonymous access needs neither an account nor a card. A separate general $200 Public Cloud trial voucher also exists but is unrelated to this free-model tier
best_for: EU-hosted, no-account access to open models

name: Fireworks AI
free_tier: $1 trial credit
rate_limits: 10 requests/min with no payment method or no credits; 6,000 RPM account-wide maximum once a payment method and active credits are on file
notes: Fireworks uses prepaid credits. After the $1 credit is exhausted, add a payment method and credits (or enable auto top-up) to continue; account limits can rise with spend
best_for: Fast hosted open models to trial with $1

name: Baseten
free_tier: New accounts receive free credits; Baseten's current pricing page does not state the amount
rate_limits: Model APIs default (models with combined token limits): Basic (unverified) 15 RPM / 100,000 TPM; Basic (verified) 120 RPM / 500,000 TPM; HTTP 429 when exceeded
notes: Basic is $0/month, pay as you go. Current pricing confirms new-account credits but does not publish an amount or expiration date. Model APIs are priced per token; dedicated deployments are priced by compute time.
best_for: Free starter credits for evaluating hosted custom and open models

name: Nebius AI Studio
free_tier: $1 trial credit, valid for 30 days
rate_limits: Default per-account RPM/TPM caps are shown in the Token Factory console and in response headers (not stated numerically in the docs; the docs' 60 RPM / 400,000 TPM baseline is labeled an illustrative example). Limits auto-scale: +20% per 15-minute window at >=80% usage, up to 20x the base
notes: Product renamed to "Nebius Token Factory"; a bank card is required to set up billing
best_for: Cheap open-model inference after a $1 trial

name: Novita AI
free_tier: $100 promotional credits valid for 90 days for eligible Novita Agent Sandbox usage (CPU, RAM, storage), granted after an account-setup survey; Novita does not say they apply to Model API calls; the pricing page also lists a few LLMs as Free (e.g. Ling 3.1 Flash, Apodex 1.1 Mini)
rate_limits: Per model, by account tier. New/low-spend accounts are Tier T1 (monthly top-ups <= $50): typically 30 RPM and 50M TPM per model (a few models 50 RPM; some 2M-5M TPM). The Free-priced LLMs (Ling 3.1 Flash, Apodex 1.1 Mini) are 30 RPM / 50M TPM at T1
notes: Signup advertises $100 Sandbox credits valid for 90 days; Novita's sandbox pricing doc describes them as credits for "eligible Novita Sandbox usage" and does not say they apply to Model API calls. No credit card required. Novita Terms of Service state that the Site and Marketplace Offerings may not be exploited for any commercial purpose without express prior written permission.
best_for: $100 credits for Novita Agent Sandbox; a few LLMs priced Free on Model APIs

name: AI21 Labs
free_tier: $10 trial credit, valid 3 months
rate_limits: Jamba Large/Mini: 10 RPS / 200 RPM by default
notes: Card not required for the trial credit itself, required once it expires
best_for: Jamba long-context models on a $10 trial

name: NLP Cloud
free_tier: $15 trial credit
rate_limits: Variable by model, no numeric RPM/TPM published
notes: Corrected: the official registration page does not ask for a phone number, contradicting the earlier listing
best_for: NLP tasks (NER, classification, summarization) on a $15 trial

name: Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio)
free_tier: Typically 1,000,000 tokens per model for new users, Singapore region (International deployment scope) only
rate_limits: Per-model, account-level limits that apply equally to free-quota and paid calls (International): e.g. qwen-plus 600 RPM / 1,000,000 TPM; qwen-flash and qwen-turbo 600 RPM / 5,000,000 TPM; qwen3.6-plus and qwen3.7-plus 15,000 RPM / 5,000,000 TPM. HTTP 429 when a limit is exceeded; HTTP 403 when the free quota is exhausted
notes: Covers real-time inference only; excludes batch invocation, fine-tuning, model deployment, custom models, PAI-DSW and OSS fees. Account information must be completed before activation. One quota per account (shared with RAM users); re-registering does not grant a new one.
best_for: Qwen models with a large free token quota (Singapore region)

name: Modal
free_tier: $30/month recurring credit (Starter plan)
rate_limits: Starter: 100 containers + 10 GPU concurrency, 5 crons, 1-day log retention
notes: Recurring monthly credit, not a one-time trial. Modal is serverless compute you deploy models on, not a hosted model API. A payment method on file is required to use Modal at all. Commercial terms: Modal Terms of Service (https://modal.com/legal/terms, read 2026-10-16) authorize use «solely for Customer's internal business» (reselling direct access prohibited), but Section 1.2 states «No-Fee Use» «may be subject to certain additional restrictions, limitations and differing terms»; the clause does not list them, so whether the Starter plan credit permits production/commercial use is not settled and commercial_ok remains null.
best_for: Self-hosting open models on free monthly GPU credit

name: SambaNova Cloud
free_tier: Rate-limited free tier (applies when no payment method is linked) across the models listed in the Free Tier table
rate_limits: Free Tier: 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 TPD listed per model in the table, enforcement scope not stated; Developer Tier (card required): 60-240 RPM depending on model
notes: Free Tier applies when no payment method is linked to the account; SambaCloud ToS grants a commercial license (no evaluation-only clause). The previously-listed "$5 / 3 months" trial could not be re-confirmed on official pages (2026-07-30). card_required is unconfirmed because SambaNova's own pages disagree (read 2026-10-08): the rate-limits doc (https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits) says "Free Tier: Applied when there is no payment method linked with your account", while the plans page (https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans) says "Add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests". Settling it needs a real signup, which has not been done. The rate-limits doc (read 2026-10-09) also lists two preview models on the Free Tier at the same 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 TPD (DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it), described there as having limited capacity and removable at short notice; they are not in models_free.
best_for: Fast open models on a rate-limited free tier

name: Scaleway Generative APIs
free_tier: 1,000,000 tokens free + 60 min Whisper transcription; billing starts at token 1,000,001
rate_limits: With a validated payment method: 300 RPM / 200k TPM per model; 600 RPM and higher TPM once identity is verified
notes: European provider (France). Free allowance is a one-time token bucket, not time-limited. Official rate limits apply once a valid payment method is registered; identity verification raises them.
best_for: EU-hosted open models with 1M free tokens

name: NVIDIA NIM
free_tier: Trial credit, phone verification required
rate_limits: Up to 40 requests/min and 10,000 requests/day; limits may vary by model and traffic from other users may cause throttling
notes: "Evaluation only, not production" per NVIDIA's own Trial Terms of Service — NVIDIA may discontinue the trial at any time with no continuity obligation
best_for: Trialling NVIDIA-optimized models (evaluation only)

name: Vercel AI Gateway
free_tier: Free tier: a monthly free credit covering a subset of models (Free Tier eligible models) at lower rate limits
rate_limits: No numeric free-tier limit published: the free tier has a lower per-model limit than paid (HTTP 429 when exceeded); Vercel documents behavior, not numbers
notes: A monthly free credit is stated in Vercel's docs (https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/pricing, read 2026-10-09); the amount is not stated there. Once you purchase credits, your account moves to the paid tier and the monthly free credit no longer applies. BYOK is not available on the free tier. It routes requests to many providers rather than hosting models itself. models_free is a sample, not the full list: the first language model, by id, of each of the first eight providers in alphabetical order among the models flagged availableToFreeTier in the page data of https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models, joined with type language in https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models and excluding priority-tier variants (isFast) and the synthetic free copy (isSyntheticFreeTier) (131 such models from 30 providers, read 2026-10-09T03:00Z; the catalogue changes). We did not verify that the rendered ?freeTier=true filter matches that field. Five models priced at zero that spend no credit are tagged free in the API: convaiinnovations/laya, convaiinnovations/laya-free (evaluation type, not chat), inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash, inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-free and poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free.
best_for: One key across many providers with a free monthly credit

name: Jina AI
free_tier: 10M free tokens (one-time) across all models — embeddings, rerankers, classifier; plus a keyless Reader (r.jina.ai) for basic use
rate_limits: Free key: 100 RPM / 100k TPM for embeddings & reranker; Reader 20 RPM keyless, 500 RPM with a free key
notes: The 10M-token balance is a one-time grant that does not replenish; the keyless Reader is genuinely ongoing. Hosted API is commercial-OK and data is not used for training. No card required.
best_for: Free embeddings & rerank behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

name: Deepgram
free_tier: $200 free credit on signup (no card, no expiration) — Nova speech-to-text and Aura text-to-speech at pay-as-you-go rates
rate_limits: STT pre-recorded up to 50 concurrent; STT streaming up to 150; TTS REST up to 15; TTS streaming up to 45
notes: No card and no expiration on the credit. Data catch: the Model Improvement Program is opt-OUT — send mip_opt_out=true per request to keep your data out of training. Native REST/WebSocket API, not OpenAI-compatible.
best_for: Biggest free credit here, for speech (STT/TTS)

name: AssemblyAI
free_tier: $50 free credit on signup (no card) — pre-recorded & streaming speech-to-text, Speech Understanding, and an OpenAI-compatible LLM Gateway (25+ models)
rate_limits: Free tier: 5 parallel transcriptions; streaming 5 new streams/min; global 20k requests / 5 min
notes: One-time credit, not renewing. Catch: the default model differs between free and paid accounts — set speech_models explicitly to avoid cost jumps on upgrade. Only the LLM Gateway is OpenAI-compatible.
best_for: Free speech-to-text plus an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway

name: Mixedbread
free_tier: Starter plan: $5 one-time credit (no card) — embeddings (mxbai-embed-large-v1), reranking, and multimodal search over PDF/image/doc/code
rate_limits: Starter plan: 100 requests/min
notes: Free credit is usage-based and non-renewing; usage-based pricing applies afterward. Native REST API, not documented as OpenAI-compatible. No card required.
best_for: No-card embeddings & rerank credit

name: Clarifai
free_tier: One-time $5 credit across serverless models (GPT-OSS-120B, Claude, Llama), vision, embeddings and image generation
rate_limits: 15 requests/second global default (CONN_THROTTLED on exceed)
notes: Could not be re-verified on 2026-11-13: docs.clarifai.com did not resolve and clarifai.com timed out. An indexed copy of Clarifai's billing page describes a one-time $5 welcome credit after phone verification that expires after 30 days; current signup and API availability remain unconfirmed. Nebius announced that Clarifai's core team joined it and licensed inference technology; that does not establish whether Clarifai's service has ended.
best_for: Multimodal (LLM + vision) models on a $5 credit

name: Arli AI
free_tier: Free plan ($0): text LLMs for testing, max 5 requests every 2 days per model, 12K context, 1 request at a time, delayed responses; no image generation
rate_limits: 5 requests every 2 days per model; 1 request at a time; max 12K context tokens
notes: Free tier is heavily rate-limited for testing. Terms and Conditions (https://www.arliai.com/terms, last updated 2026-07-28), Intellectual Property Rights: «All results that you receive in response to your prompts (or other inputs) from models accessible via the Services will collectively be considered "Your Content." You retain full ownership of Your Content to the extent permitted by applicable law and have the right to use Your Content for any purpose.» No clause limits the free plan to personal or non-commercial use; the pricing page presents it as «Test out the Arli platform». Models served are subject to their own licences (Terms, Third-Party Models: «The models accessible through the Services may include open-weight or third-party models that are subject to their own license terms, acceptable use policies, or other restrictions (including, for example, model-specific use policies that may limit certain use cases).»); some open-weight models restrict commercial use. Provider says prompt/output content is not logged or stored; usage metadata may be retained for up to 60 days. Card requirement for the free tier is not stated on the pricing page.
best_for: A permanently-free (heavily rate-limited) test tier

name: Ollama Cloud
free_tier: Unconfirmed: Ollama's August 2026 announcement describes monthly starter cloud usage, but its current pricing page lists Pay as you go and does not state a free allowance
rate_limits: Current Pay as you go pricing lists 3 concurrent requests; a limit for free cloud usage is not confirmed
notes: First-party cloud API; an ollama.com account and API key are required. Checked 2026-11-13: current pricing says cloud requests consume usage credits, while the August 2026 announcement still describes monthly free starter usage. The former Free plan's 1-request limit and renewal claim cannot be confirmed from current pricing. Running models locally on your own hardware is a separate offering. Card requirement remains unknown.
best_for: Cloud-hosted open models with the Ollama workflow

name: AI Horde
free_tier: Free crowdsourced text & image generation; anonymous API key '0000000000' (no registration), or register to earn kudos for priority
rate_limits: Queue-based priority via kudos (no fixed quota); anonymous requests get lowest priority under load
notes: Community-powered volunteer network — model availability and speed vary with worker supply, so it is not a fixed-SLA service. No card, no phone. Kudos never expire and cannot be sold. Commercial use is conditional: each model carries its own licence (aihorde.net UI displays 'Commercial use: allowed' or 'Pick something else if you plan to sell what you make or use it in a business'), and the official AI Horde FAQ (https://aihorde.net/faq/) says paid services built on the API must give back to the Horde at least as much as they take.
best_for: Anonymous, no-signup free generation (variable speed)
commercial_ok_condition: Per-model licence (some models forbid commercial use), and paid services using the API must give back to the Horde at least as much as they take.

name: ModelScope (API-Inference)
free_tier: Free API-Inference calls paid with daily 'Magicubes': 200/day for signing in + 50/day after linking an Alibaba Cloud account (do not roll over); calls cost ~0.5 / 1 / 2 Magicubes for lightweight / standard / flagship models
rate_limits: Bounded by the daily Magicubes: ~250/day from signing in and linking an Alibaba Cloud account, plus any earned by other actions (~125-500 calls depending on model tier); concurrency dynamically limited, single concurrency guaranteed
notes: Alibaba's model hub — a different product from Alibaba Model Studio. Requires a ModelScope account bound to an Alibaba Cloud account with real-name (ID) verification — a practical barrier for non-China users. Explicitly non-commercial ("for developers to experience"). No card.
best_for: Free daily calls to many open models (Alibaba Cloud real-name verification required)

name: Pollinations.ai
free_tier: Quest Pollen: create an account, complete eligible Quests on the Quests dashboard and claim the rewards; Quest Pollen is spent before paid Pollen on regular (non-paid-only) models. No anonymous/no-key generation — every generation endpoint requires an API key and costs Pollen ($1 ≈ 1 Pollen). Text, image, video, audio, embeddings and 3D models behind one OpenAI-compatible API
rate_limits: No per-request rate limits published for sk_ keys; usage is bounded by the Pollen balance (legacy raw pk_ keys: 1 Pollen per IP per hour)
notes: The old anonymous 1 req/15s and Seed 1 req/5s tiers (and the watermark/nologo scheme) are gone from the current docs; the API moved to gen.pollinations.ai with keys from enter.pollinations.ai. Quest availability and reward amounts change (the dashboard and the linked issue are the source of truth). No credit card needed to try. Paid-only models require Paid Pollen. Section 8 of the Terms of Service says: "Model licences vary; verify before commercial use." This guidance concerns model licences and does not explicitly establish whether the hosted API or free Quest Pollen tier may be used commercially. commercial_ok remains null. Source: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/b9bf075ae6d5931758dae3f88604e9c58f3760a3/pollinations.ai/public/legal/TERMS_OF_SERVICE.md (read 2026-10-16). The previous docs_url pointed at the stale master branch; the default branch is main.
best_for: OpenAI-compatible multi-modal API funded by Quest Pollen (no card)

name: Runware
free_tier: $2 in free credits for new users who sign up with a business email, usable on the Models API (image, video, audio, LLM and 3D models) on the Sonic Inference Engine
rate_limits: Per-organization REST rate limit counted in results per second (number not published; "sits far above typical traffic"); no hard concurrency limit (2-4 concurrent requests recommended)
notes: The $2 requires signup with a business email; no credit card required. Commercial use of Outputs is allowed, subject to each model's licence (Partner Models are cleared for commercial use by Runware). Third-party provider models are subject to those providers' own rate limits.
best_for: Fast image models with a $2 no-card credit

name: Pinecone Inference
free_tier: Starter (free) plan: 5M embedding tokens/month per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large, pinecone-sparse-english-v0) and 500 rerank requests/month (bge-reranker-v2-m3; the rate-limits doc also lists pinecone-rerank-v0 at 500)
rate_limits: Starter: 5M embedding tokens/mo per model; 250K embedding tokens/min per model (passage); 500 rerank requests/mo and 60 rerank requests/min per model; 100 inference requests/s and 2,000/min per project
notes: Monthly limits are hard: reaching one returns 429 and you must upgrade (no pay-as-you-go overage on Starter). The pricing page lists only bge-reranker-v2-m3 as included on Starter while the rate-limits doc also lists pinecone-rerank-v0 at 500 — an internal inconsistency. Not OpenAI-compatible. Card requirement for Starter not stated on the pricing page or docs. No card was required at signup when last confirmed (2026-08); the current pages do not mention it.
best_for: Free embeddings + rerank for RAG (5M tokens/mo per model)

name: Twelve Labs (Marengo Embed)
free_tier: Free plan: the Marengo 3.5 Embed API (video, audio, image, text and document inputs) and the Pegasus Analyze API at no cost, plus 600 minutes (10 hours) of video indexing in total
rate_limits: Embed video/audio: 3,000 RPD, 25 RPM; embed text/image: 3,000 RPD, 600 RPM
notes: No credit card for the Free plan, but indexed data expires after 90 days unless upgraded. Marengo produces multimodal embeddings. Not OpenAI-compatible.
best_for: Free multimodal (video/audio/image/text) embeddings

name: OCR.space
free_tier: 25,000 conversions/month (Engine 1 & 2) plus 1,000 Engine 3 conversions/month; max 1 MB file, PDFs up to 3 pages
rate_limits: 500 requests per day per IP address
notes: Free searchable-PDF output carries a watermark (raw text extraction is unrestricted); the free key needs only an email, no card. Commercial use permitted.
best_for: Classic free OCR (25k conversions/mo, no card)

name: LlamaParse (LlamaCloud)
free_tier: Free plan: 10,000 credits/month (up to ~10,000 pages at the cheapest parse tier, as low as 1 credit/page)
rate_limits: 5 concurrent jobs; 1 project; 5 indexes on the free plan
notes: Credit-based (1,000 credits = $1.25); premium parse modes consume more credits per page. No card required. Document parsing for RAG (LlamaIndex).
best_for: Free document parsing for RAG (~10k pages/mo)

name: Nanonets
free_tier: $50 in free credits on signup (one-time) across data-extraction / OCR workflows
rate_limits: Not published by the provider
notes: One-time signup credit, not renewing (credits never expire); no credit card required to start. Paid plans start at $100/month afterwards.
best_for: Document extraction on a $50 no-card credit

name: Moondream Cloud
free_tier: $5/month usage credits in every workspace (Free plan) for the Moondream vision model — caption, query (VQA), detect, point
rate_limits: 2 requests/sec on the free tier (10 req/sec with ≥$10 account balance); usage bounded by the $5/month credit
notes: Last updated 2025-12-10. Commercial use of the free tier is unclear: §4.1 permits use for «internal business or personal purposes», while §4.2 prohibits «commercially exploit the Service or any portion of the Service». The terms do not explicitly clarify whether commercial use is permitted on the free tier.
best_for: Tiny vision model, OpenAI-compatible, monthly free credit

name: Speechmatics
free_tier: Free plan: $100 credit grant on signup (no payment card) for Speech-to-Text; Text-to-Speech lists the first 1 million characters free
rate_limits: Free: 2 concurrent real-time sessions; Batch API: 10 new jobs/s and 50 job-status requests/s (bounded by the $100 credit)
notes: One-time $100 credit grant, no card required; to go beyond it, add a card and move to Pro (pay-as-you-go). Accounts created before 1 August 2026 received a one-time $25 transition credit. No data logging for model training by default. Terms of Service 3.1 licenses the Software to produce Integrated Products, 4.4 only bars reselling the Software as a standalone product, and 10.3 assigns to the customer all rights in the Transcripts; Free Usage (5.1) is part of the same terms, and no clause limits it to evaluation or non-commercial use.
best_for: High-accuracy STT + TTS on a $100 no-card credit

name: Speechify API
free_tier: 500K characters/month TTS (hard cap; pauses until next month), catalog voices, streaming and SSML
rate_limits: Free: 3 concurrent requests, 1 request/s sustained (burst 10); hard monthly cap, no top-ups
notes: Commercial use is allowed on the free tier. No credit card required. Free cannot top up and pauses when the monthly balance runs out. Voice cloning is paid-plan only; voice agents are now an enterprise-only product (no free minutes).
best_for: Free commercial TTS (500K chars/mo)

name: Hume AI (Octave TTS)
free_tier: Free tier for Octave TTS and EVI; new accounts start with $20 in credits
rate_limits: Rate set by subscription tier, numbers not published; max 5,000 characters per utterance and 5 generations per request
notes: Free and Starter tiers are non-commercial only (commercial use starts on Creator). The Free plan cannot buy overage, so going past it means upgrading. Not OpenAI-compatible. The former plan quota (10,000 characters/month) is no longer on a live official page: hume.ai/pricing redirected to the homepage on 2026-10-08.
best_for: Expressive TTS to prototype with (the free tier is non-commercial)

name: Unreal Speech
free_tier: 250,000 characters/month TTS (~6 hours of audio)
rate_limits: No rate limit published in the current V8 API docs (legacy v7 docs listed 2 requests/second on Free). Per-request size: /stream up to 1,000 characters, /speech up to 3,000, /synthesisTasks up to 500,000
notes: Commercial use allowed, but free-plan users must attribute Unreal Speech with a link when publishing audio. First-party REST endpoints. No credit card required.
best_for: Largest free TTS (250k chars/mo, attribution)

name: ElevenLabs
free_tier: 10,000 credits/month shared across Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text and more (~10 min TTS/month)
rate_limits: 2 concurrent requests on the Free plan
notes: The free tier is NON-COMMERCIAL only per the Terms of Use (commercial license starts on paid Starter, $6/mo); non-commercial use requires a personal email address. Free-plan credits do not roll over. API access is available on the free plan. No credit card to sign up.
best_for: Best-known TTS voices (free tier is non-commercial)

name: Sarvam AI
free_tier: ₹100 in free credits on signup, usable across any API including chat completion (Sarvam-105B) and speech (STT/TTS); credits never expire
rate_limits: Starter plan: 40 req/min for chat with Sarvam-105B (60 for other default models), STT REST and TTS REST (bulbul:v3: 30 req/min); 20 concurrent STT WebSocket streams; bounded by the ₹100 credit
notes: One-time signup credit shared across all APIs; credits never expire. Sarvam-M has been deprecated (use Sarvam-105B). Signup credits carry commercial production rights for generated Output. Card/phone requirement not stated in the docs. The docs list limits per plan but do not say explicitly that free-credit accounts are on Starter. India-focused provider (pricing in INR), strong Indic-language models.
best_for: Indic-language chat + speech via one OpenAI-compatible key

name: Gladia
free_tier: €50 in free credits on signup for speech-to-text (~80+ hrs pre-recorded or 60+ hrs real-time at current rates)
rate_limits: 30 real-time and 25 async concurrent requests (Starter pay-as-you-go plan that carries the €50 credit)
notes: One-time grant with no monthly reset; prepaid model: top up once the credit is consumed. General Terms of Use (Gladia Inc, https://www.gladia.io/general-terms-of-use-gladia-inc, read 2026-10-17) section 7 licenses Output solely for «internal, personal and commercial purposes», but conditions the licence on «payment of all applicable fees» and does not mention free credits or trials, so commercial use of the signup credit is unconfirmed. Card requirement not explicitly stated on the pricing page.
best_for: High-accuracy async + real-time transcription to trial

name: Rime
free_tier: Free minutes for every new account (Starter plan): the pricing card says ~800 minutes (~800k characters), while the FAQ and docs say 3,000
rate_limits: Starter: 20 concurrent TTS generations
notes: One-time allotment on signup; no credit card required (stated on the pricing page). The pricing table shows ~800 free minutes (~800k characters) while the page's own FAQ and the docs still say 3,000; an internal inconsistency. Terms of Service section 4 states that customers retain all rights in and to their Input and Output; section 3 forbids using Output to train an AI model and reselling the Services; section 4 defers trial rights to «the terms of such trial», so commercial use of the free minutes is unconfirmed.
best_for: Low-latency conversational TTS to prototype

name: Tencent Hunyuan
free_tier: One-time TokenHub new-user trial (Hunyuan has moved to TokenHub): 1,000,000 free tokens for each language model and each multimodal-understanding model, claimable once per main account; offer runs until 2026-12-31. The legacy Hunyuan free package (1,000,000 tokens shared across text/vision models plus 1,000,000 for Hunyuan-embedding) is no longer offered: the old platform stopped new purchases on 2026-06-30
rate_limits: ChatCompletions (Tencent Cloud API): default 5 concurrent requests per account; GetEmbedding: 5 requests/second (both marked pre-offline, expected 2026-12-21). A limit of 20 requests/second for the other Hunyuan APIs is not stated on any official API page checked on 2026-10-15, so it is not confirmed
notes: Tencent has moved Hunyuan to TokenHub, its model-service platform. Per Tencent's migration notice, the legacy platform stopped new purchases on 2026-06-30, and its console and APIs were due to close on 2026-09-30; the legacy ChatCompletions and GetEmbedding API pages (updated 2026-09-23) still list an expected shutdown of 2026-12-21, so the two official sources disagree. The four vision models in the old free package (Tencent HY Vision 1.5 Instruct, hunyuan-turbos-vision, hunyuan-t1-vision, hunyuan-turbos-vision-video) left the old platform on 2026-06-22. TokenHub trial: the free quota is used first, unused quota expires, and once it runs out calls stop unless post-paid billing is enabled. The new-user free package page (the docs_url, updated 2026-09-04, read 2026-10-17) gives 1,000,000 tokens with a validity of 1 year for all language models and for all multimodal-understanding models, counted from the day the quota is claimed (the page says 免费额度从领取时起算), after which the unused part expires; the 3-month validity in Tencent's migration notice applies only to the separate free quota for users who complete the migration from the old platform. The same page adds that the validity differs between models, so check the model you plan to use. TokenHub requires Tencent Cloud real-name verification (enterprise or personal) — a practical barrier for many non-China users. openai_base_url is TokenHub's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the legacy endpoint (api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com/v1) belongs to the closed platform. Tencent documents the same two hosts under two domains, one per documentation site: the China site (cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130078, updated 2026-10-13) lists tokenhub.tencentmaas.com (Guangzhou) and tokenhub-intl.tencentmaas.com (Singapore); the international site (intl.cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1300/80632, updated 2026-10-09, AI-translated) lists tokenhub.tencentcloudmaas.com and tokenhub-intl.tencentcloudmaas.com, and a Silicon Valley host. This entry uses the first, as the China-site quick start does. Read 2026-10-17. Commercial-use terms not stated.
best_for: Chinese-language LLM workloads via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

name: Voyage AI
free_tier: 200M free tokens per model on current embedding models (voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4, voyage-code-4) and on the rerankers listed in the price table (rerank-3, rerank-3-lite); voyage-multimodal-3.5 and voyage-multimodal-3 get 200M text tokens + 150B pixels; legacy voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2 get 50M — a one-time complimentary allotment per account
rate_limits: No numeric limit published for accounts without a payment method. With a payment method (Tier 1, free tokens still apply), per model: voyage-4 / voyage-code-4 8M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-4-large / voyage-context-4 3M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-4-lite 16M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-multimodal-3.5 2M TPM, 2,000 RPM; rerank-3 / rerank-2.5 2M TPM, 2,000 RPM; rerank-3-lite / rerank-2.5-lite 4M TPM, 2,000 RPM. HTTP 429 on exceed
notes: The allotment is a one-time complimentary balance per model, not a renewing monthly quota. Free tokens do not apply to Batch API usage. Voyage's pricing page is internally inconsistent on rerankers: the prose still names the rerank-2.5/rerank-2 families as free, while the price table gives 200M free tokens to rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite and lists rerank-2.5 under older models with no free tokens. No credit card required to claim. Owned by MongoDB — a first-party model provider, not a proxy.
best_for: Best-in-class embeddings and reranking with a large free allotment

name: Contextual AI
free_tier: $25 in free credits on the on-demand plan, usable on the Rerank (rerank-v2) and Generate APIs
rate_limits: Not published by the provider (Rerank requests capped at 400,000 tokens each)
notes: One-time signup credit (does not renew); the instruction-following reranker is the standout free capability. Commercial-use terms not stated on the pricing page.
best_for: A strong instruction-following reranker to try for free

name: Cartesia
free_tier: 20,000 credits/month (~27 min of Sonic TTS or ~1h51 of Ink speech-to-text)
rate_limits: 2 concurrent TTS requests, 8 concurrent STT; 20,000 credits/month
notes: Commercial use is NOT allowed on the free plan (the $5/mo Pro plan adds a commercial licence). Low-latency streaming voice over WebSocket/REST; own API (not OpenAI-shaped).
best_for: Low-latency streaming TTS + STT on a renewing monthly free quota

name: Fish Audio
free_tier: App Free plan: 8,000 credits/month (~7 min, up to 500 characters per generation). API: the s2.1-pro-free TTS model is $0 through 2026-11-30 under fair-use limits (pay-as-you-go API, no subscription)
rate_limits: API: 5 concurrent requests (Starter tier, <$100 paid); s2.1-pro-free under unpublished fair-use limits. App Free plan: 500 characters per generation, 8,000 credits/month
notes: Free app plan is personal, non-commercial only (commercial use requires Premium). The $0 API model s2.1-pro-free is pitched for testing, prototyping and smaller businesses but has no TTFA/DPA guarantees. No credit card required for the Free plan.
best_for: Free multilingual TTS with voice cloning for personal projects

name: Camb.ai
free_tier: Free plan: 5,000 credits one-time (no monthly renewal) across TTS, dubbing, speech and translation tools
rate_limits: Not published by the provider; bounded by the one-time 5,000-credit grant
notes: Uses its own MARS voice models (not OpenAI-compatible). Free credits are a one-time grant, not monthly. Per-feature limits (characters per generation, watermarking) are not readable on the current pricing page. Card and commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.
best_for: Expressive multilingual TTS, STT and dubbing on one free quota

name: Rev AI
free_tier: Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR (speech-to-text), usable across all Rev AI products
rate_limits: Bounded by the 5-hour credit grant
notes: Free credits are available at signup. Section 2.1 limits use to internal business purposes during the applicable Order Term, while section 2.2(f) prohibits providing access as part of a service bureau or similar fee-for-service purpose. Sections 2.1 and 2.2 do not say whether signup free credits constitute an Order, so commercial use of these credits is unconfirmed. Source: https://www.rev.com/legal/terms (read 2026-10-15).
best_for: 5 free hours of high-accuracy speech-to-text to evaluate

name: Unstructured
free_tier: 10,000 free pages once per account — document parsing/OCR (layout, tables, generative OCR enrichment); then $0.015/page pay-as-you-go
rate_limits: No public request-rate or concurrency limits for the Transform API; one document per request, 50 MB per document; free allotment 10,000 pages in total
notes: No credit card required. The free pages are a one-time credit per account (not monthly); after 10,000 pages, processing requests fail until you upgrade to Pay-As-You-Go. Purpose-built to turn documents into clean, structured input for RAG/LLM pipelines. Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.
best_for: Turning messy documents into LLM-ready structured data (10,000 free pages to start)

name: Nutrient (Data Extraction API)
free_tier: 5,000 credits/month (renews; no rollover) — ~5,000 text-parse pages, fewer for OCR-heavy 'Understand'/'Agentic' parsing (9-18 credits/page)
rate_limits: 5,000 credits/month; Parse costs 1-18 credits/page by mode (Extract 7-24)
notes: No credit card required. Formerly PSPDFKit. Extraction/OCR with tables, key-value and handwriting. Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.
best_for: Document data extraction with a genuinely renewing free monthly quota

name: Photoroom
free_tier: 10 free production calls on the Remove Background API (one-time) plus 1,000 sandbox calls/month on the Image Editing API (watermarked)
rate_limits: 1,000 sandbox calls/month; 10 one-time production calls
notes: No credit card required. Sandbox output is watermarked (for testing); the 10 production calls return clean output. Image editing/generation (AI backgrounds, relighting, shadows).
best_for: Programmatic background removal and AI image editing to prototype free

name: Poolside
free_tier: Free developer API key via Poolside Platform for Poolside's Laguna coding models (current lineup: Laguna S 2.1, Laguna XS 2.1, Laguna M.1); which models and limits apply to the free key is not documented
rate_limits: Not published
notes: Coding-focused models. Docs describe Poolside Platform as "fast, free developer access"; paid access with a larger context window is via OpenRouter. The earlier 'free for a limited time' wording no longer appears in the current docs, and no end date is published. Self-serve key at platform.poolside.ai. No card was required at signup when last confirmed (2026-08); the current pages do not mention it.
best_for: Free coding-focused LLMs behind an OpenAI-compatible key

name: Upstage
free_tier: $10 free credit on sign-up (per Upstage's Getting Started docs) for the API — Solar LLM (chat + embeddings) plus Document Parse / OCR / information extraction; Studio document agents include 10 free runs each
rate_limits: Tier 0 (below the Explore commitment tier): Solar Pro 4 100 RPM / 250,000 TPM; Solar Mini 4 100 RPM / 50,000 TPM; Embeddings 100 RPM / 300,000 TPM; Document OCR 3 requests/second, 500 pages/minute
notes: The Solar Pro 4 free window (2026-08-05 to 2026-08-11) has ended; standard pricing is $0.30 input / $1.20 output per 1M tokens from 2026-10-11 (UTC), after a 70%-off phase that runs until 2026-10-10. Beyond the signup credit, API use is pay-per-use, with prepaid commitment tiers from $100/mo adding bonus credit and higher limits. Studio agent runs need no card. A separate institutional grant (up to 1 year of free Solar Pro + Document Parse) exists for eligible schools, hospitals and nonprofits only. Solar Pro 2/3 and Solar Mini are deprecated on 2026-10-30 (KST). Data policy evidence: Terms of Use, Article 22(6): "Member Input/Output Data generated through services provided free of charge (excluding services temporarily provided free of charge for promotional purposes in anticipation of paid services) may be used for service provision and improvement, as well as for research and development of artificial intelligence technologies (including training)." Privacy Policy, Free Tier API row: "Until the end of service provision or a separately notified period." Whether the signup credit counts as the "temporarily provided free of charge for promotional purposes in anticipation of paid services" exception is not stated on either page, so trains_on_prompts stays null (unconfirmed) and only the retention is recorded. Sources read 2026-10-13: https://www.upstage.ai/terms-of-service/update-may-06-2026 ; https://www.upstage.ai/privacy-policy/updated-aug-26-2026
best_for: Solar LLM + document OCR behind one OpenAI-compatible key

name: Veryfi
free_tier: Free Forever plan: up to 100 documents/month — OCR plus structured data extraction (receipts, invoices, and 100+ document types)
rate_limits: 100 documents/month on the free plan
notes: No credit card required. The 'Free Forever' 100 docs/mo tier is the standing free tier (a separate 14-day trial unlocks paid features). Proprietary OCR / document-intelligence REST API.
best_for: Free-forever document OCR (100 docs/mo, no card)

name: Voicegain
free_tier: $50 in free credits on signup (no credit card) — speech-to-text
rate_limits: Default for new accounts: 75 API requests/minute and 2,000/hour; 4 concurrent real-time ASR requests; OFF-LINE transcription up to 4 hours of audio per hour (queue of 10 jobs)
notes: No credit card required to start — an explicit $50 platform credit on signup; afterwards cloud STT is billed at $0.00020/second of audio (6-second minimum per request). Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page. Native STT REST API. The former /pricing URL now redirects to /developers.
best_for: Largest no-card speech-to-text credit ($50)

name: Smallest.ai (Waves)
free_tier: $10 in free credits with full access on Pay As You Go — TTS (Lightning v3.1), STT (Pulse) and voice agents; speech-to-speech (Hydra) is beta/request-access
rate_limits: Pay As You Go: 15 concurrent TTS streams, 100 TTS requests/min, 450M chars/month cap; 100 concurrent STT streams; 20 concurrent agent calls (bounded by the $10 credit)
notes: $10 starting credit on Pay As You Go. The models pricing page lists 15 concurrent TTS streams while the API reference still says 1 active TTS request per account; inconsistent. The models table shows Voice Cloning 'No' for Pay As You Go although the TTS card advertises instant cloning. Terms of Service (effective 2026-10-13), section 9(j): «Use the Services, or any portion thereof, for any commercial purpose or for the benefit of any third party or in any manner not permitted by these Terms»; section 8(b): «You may not sell or share the Output with any third parties for commercial benefit or purposes». The Trial Services paragraph (the $10 trial credit) does not mention commercial use, so it does not exempt trial use. The same Terms describe the Services as letting you create AI agents that make and receive calls, so the prohibition reads wider than the free credit alone. /pricing now redirects to /pricing/agents.
best_for: Fast TTS + STT on a $10 credit

name: Retell AI
free_tier: $10 in free trial credits (once per email address) plus 20 concurrent calls included — voice-agent orchestration (STT + LLM + TTS)
rate_limits: 20 concurrent calls per workspace (Pay-As-You-Go default)
notes: $10 trial credit with full platform access, granted once per email address. A payment method is required only to buy phone numbers or use the service beyond the free trial. A voice-agent builder (orchestration), not a raw model API. Voice agents cost ~$0.07-$0.31/min after the credit. Terms of Service (updated 2026-10-07, https://www.retellai.com/terms-of-service) section 10.2 licenses the Service «for your personal or internal business purposes» and section 10.4 licenses AI-Generated Content «for Your personal or internal business purposes»; neither explicitly authorizes commercial use or mentions the $10 credit. Pricing page (https://www.retellai.com/pricing) advertises full platform access.
best_for: Build a voice agent on a $10 no-card trial credit

name: Datalab (Marker / Surya)
free_tier: $20/month (work email) or $10/month (personal email) free usage allowance for the hosted document AI API
rate_limits: Official sources disagree: API limits docs say 10 requests/min and 5 concurrent; pricing says 25 requests/min and 25 concurrent. Exact free-tier request quota is not confirmed
notes: Monthly allowance requires no card and resets each 30-day cycle without rollover. Billing and API limits docs disagree with the pricing table on request limits (read 2026-11-14). Commercial permission for the hosted free API remains unconfirmed; self-hosted model licence conditions are separate. Phone requirement was checked via Google signup on 2026-10-02 and was not re-tested in this pass
best_for: Open-source-pedigree OCR (Marker/Surya) on a free monthly allowance

name: W&B Inference
free_tier: Serverless Inference credits on the Free plan "for a limited time" (amount not published); Free accounts have a default spending cap of $100/month
rate_limits: No RPM/TPM published; per-project and per-user concurrency limits (HTTP 429 when exceeded); default spending cap $100/month on the Free tier
notes: W&B Inference is now documented as CoreWeave Forge Serverless Inference (docs.wandb.ai redirects to docs.coreweave.com). The $100/month figure is a default spending cap, not a stated free-credit amount. When credits run out, Free accounts must activate pay-as-you-go on the Billing tab or upgrade; CoreWeave requires prepayment for paid access. Available only from supported geographic locations. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.inference.wandb.ai/v1; API keys are created at forge.coreweave.com. The pricing page lists "$5/mo free credit for a limited time" only under Pro and "Billed monthly" under Free, so the Free amount is unclear.
best_for: Open-weight frontier models (DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, GLM, GPT-OSS) behind one unified API with Weave tracing

name: Typhoon (SCB 10X)
free_tier: Free to use research showcase API — all Typhoon models at $0
rate_limits: typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct: 5 requests/second, 200 requests/minute; typhoon-ocr: 2 requests/second, 20 requests/minute; typhoon-asr-realtime: 100 requests/minute
notes: By SCB 10X, the venture arm of Siam Commercial Bank, focused on Thai-language models. The free catalog spans LLMs (typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct), OCR (typhoon-ocr family) and realtime Thai ASR (typhoon-asr-realtime, typhoon-isan-asr-realtime) — the hosted API is OpenAI-compatible, including audio transcriptions. Beta, provided as-is with no formal support; usage data is collected to improve the model; SCB claims no rights in outputs. Sign up for a free API key at opentyphoon.ai.
best_for: Thai-language LLMs, OCR and speech via an OpenAI-compatible research API
